line.s_garland.text: I am making a garland for the party. Apple, pear, apple, pear.

line.s_go_on.text: I have to fetch some string. Will you finish it for me?

line.s_anything.text: Sure! I'll add anything, as long as it is colourful. Hop, hop!

line.s_broken.text: Oh no, you broke the pattern! Look: apple, pear, apple, pear. Something repeats.

line.s_rhythm.text: What fits the rhythm! A rhythm is something that repeats in order.

line.s_what.text: A rhythm? Will you show me?

line.s_same_garland.text: The garland has the same kind of rhythm. Apple, pear, apple, pear. Let's start again.

line.s_fill.text: Drag what comes next. Careful, one thing does not fit!

line.wrong_pattern.text: That does not fit the rhythm. What came before this place?

line.s_solved.text: The garland is ready! Apple, pear, apple, pear, all the way.

line.s_to_garden.text: Let's go to the garden. There are rhythms there too.

line.b_bed.text: In the bed there grows: flower, flower, carrot. And again: flower, flower, carrot.

line.b_done.text: Flower, flower, carrot! The rhythm is right.

line.b_to_meadow.text: Now a picnic by the lake.

line.c_picnic.text: I am laying the table: cup, plate, spoon. Cup, plate, spoon.

line.c_solved.text: Cup, plate, spoon! Now you can finish any rhythm.

line.p_intro.text: Let's play rhythms! Look at what repeats.

line.p_fill.text: What comes next? Drag it into the empty places.

line.a_ok.text: All right! I start and you finish.

line.a_fill.text: What comes next? Drag the toys.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to make a rhythm of spoons and forks with you. You can also clap a rhythm together.
